MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 56

2. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

4. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 24

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

6. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 15

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

12. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 73

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 41

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
